business_summary: Fujimak Corporation engages in the manufacture, sale, maintenance, and repair of commercial kitchen equipment in Japan and internationally. The company offers ovens, teppanyaki grills, fryer oil filters, gas ranges, induction stoves, warmers, griddles, salamander roasters, noodle boilers, rotary cooking kettle braising pans, dumpling grillers, steamers, package cookers, and reheating cabinets, as well as electric ranges, tables, and stock pot ranges; refrigerators, freezers, blast chillers, showcases, cold food carts, ice makers, and vacuum and tabletop coolers; Kitchen Link Cloud, a cloud-based temperature management system; Kitchen Link, a system that centrally manages data; I-Robo2, a stir-fry cooking robot; finibo, a system that automates the picking and sorting cleaned dishes; and island and custom-made home kitchens. It also provides dishwashers, cookware washers, sterilizer cabinets, and ultraviolet sterilizers; cleaning agents for washing machines; carts; automatic rice cookers, storage products, and silos; bakery equipment; cabinets and camshelving equipment; Pacojet, a frozen pulverizing cooker; vacuum packing machines, blenders and mixers, and cookers; gelato/ice cream service equipment, drink dispensers and machines, auxiliary cooking equipment, and water heaters; and sanitary sinks and bars, automatic hand sanitizer dispensers, air showers, electrolyzed water generators, digital probe thermometers, and water softeners and purifiers. The company sells its products online. It serves government agencies and public institutions; educational institutions and school lunch centers; medical and welfare facilities; hotels, inns, and lodging facilities; restaurants and izakayas; amusement facilities; fast food establishments; convenience stores; food processing plants and central kitchens; company cafeterias; ship kitchen facilities; and other industries. Fujimak Corporation was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Fujimak Corporation은 일본 및 해외에서 상업용 주방 장비의 제조, 판매, 유지 관리 및 수리에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 오븐, 철판 구이 그릴, 프라이어 오일 필터, 가스 레인지, 인덕션 스토브, 워머, 철판, 도롱뇽 로스터, 국수 보일러, 회전 조리 주전자 브레이징 팬, 만두 그릴러, 찜기, 패키지 쿠커 및 재가열 캐비닛뿐만 아니라 전기 레인지, 테이블 및 냄비 레인지도 제공합니다. 냉장고, 냉동고, 급속 냉각기, 진열장, 차가운 식품 카트, 제빙기, 진공 및 탁상용 냉각기; 클라우드 기반 온도 관리 시스템인 Kitchen Link Cloud; 데이터를 중앙에서 관리하는 시스템인 Kitchen Link; 볶음요리로봇 아이로보2(I-Robo2); 세척된 식기를 자동으로 선별하고 분류하는 시스템인 finibo; 섬과 맞춤형 가정용 주방이 있습니다. 또한 식기세척기, 조리기구 세척기, 살균기 캐비닛, 자외선 살균기도 제공합니다. 세탁기용 세척제; 카트; 자동밥솥, 저장제품, 사일로; 베이커리 장비; 캐비닛 및 캠쉘빙 장비; 냉동분쇄밥솥 파코제트; 진공 포장기, 블렌더 및 믹서, 쿠커; 젤라또/아이스크림
